log.msg: word list decided: ui-contrast and ui-compact, two words, plus --density as the knob. No micro/mini/small ladder - three sizes on one axis is a value, not a thing, and this repo already ruled that (avatar/sizes -> --avatar, stats/summary -> --column). zoom is frozen at eight rungs as the cautionary precedent.

mechanism: a word sets custom properties and NOTHING else - no element selectors, no component classes, no !important. Cost per component is zero lines; two words compose by inheriting; a word works on html, .app, a section or one card identically.

trap found: --flow cannot be set from an ancestor. framework.css declares it ON the flow root, :where(.flow, blockquote) { --flow: 2em }, (0,0,0), so an inherited value is overwritten at every flow and a compact section keeps 2em prose rhythm with nothing in the console. words.js carries a (0,1,0) descendant pair.
ui-compact deliberately does not touch font-size. Shrinking type is zoom and it already exists; density is less space at the SAME reading size. Different thing, different word.

ui-contrast names no hue: alpha bumps on the light-dark pairs framework.css already declared, the ends of the ink axis, and --prim-ink as color-mix(in oklab, var(--prim) 70%, var(--ink)). One word covers light and dark and any theme.

band choice: words goes in Marks (4 -> 5). Marks was the only band under five and therefore the worst at 3440 (four cards ~760px each); ui/doc/decisions.md already ruled that band ARITHMETIC beats semantics - it killed the cleaner five-band cut over two bands of three.

trap that cost a cycle: an edit inserted prose between a comment's */ and the .ui-compact rule inside the same css() string. The sheet still loaded, .ui-contrast still worked, .ui-compact was silently dead. A loaded stylesheet is not evidence that YOUR rule is in it - read a computed value back.

trap: a custom property inherits, so the demo caption wrapper's tidy inline --gap 0.5em leaked into the section being compared and BOTH panels measured 7.52px - the default panel wearing the compact gap. Caught by measurement, invisible by eye.

found and dropped: --radius. Themes own it (lew42 0.25em, terminal 0) and CSS cannot scale a property from itself, so calc(0.5em * 0.5) measured 3.76px against the theme's own 3.76px - a no-op that would have overruled a theme's corners. Rule generalised: a word may only touch a token nothing else declares.
ui.table() puts a cell straight into a td - no markdown pass - so backticks and **stars** in cells rendered literally on both new pages. Fixed; noted in ui/readme.md.
Marks band 4 -> 5 wraps 4+1 at 1600, same as Surfaces and Forms already do at that width; at 3440 all three bands draw five in one row, which is what the band sizes were tuned for.
toggles proven, not described: clicked both buttons off headless and both panels measured 15.22px padding, identical. Table cells checked for stray backticks/stars on both new pages - zero.

assign.outcome:
**Two config words that re-skin a whole section, and a `ux/` tier that states the system.** A word is a class on a section that remaps framework tokens, so twenty `ui/` templates re-skin and not one of them has a line about it.

![](words.png)

Left default, right the identical markup inside `.ui-contrast.ui-compact`. Measured at 1280: padding 7.52px vs 15.04px, gap the same, font-size 15.04px in BOTH - density is less space at the same reading size, not zoom.

**The words.** `ui-contrast` remaps --ink --subtle --line --wash --tint --prim-ink and names no hue (alpha bumps on the light-dark pairs framework.css already declared, the ends of the ink axis, and --prim-ink as a color-mix), so one word covers light, dark and any theme. `ui-compact` remaps --pad --gap --flow, scaled by `--density`. No micro/mini/small: three values on one axis is a value, not a thing, and the half step is `.style("--density", "0.7")` - the slider on the demo page is that call.

**The contract.** A word sets custom properties and nothing else: no element selectors, no component classes, no !important. Zero lines per component, two words compose, works the same on html, .app, a section or one card. And a word REPLACES a token, it can never SCALE one - `calc(var(--radius) * var(--density))` self-references and CSS drops it - so it may only touch a token nothing else declares. --radius failed that (the theme owns it) and was measured at 3.76px against the theme's own 3.76px, then removed.

**Landed:** [ux/](/framework/ux/) (readme + page + [doc/system.md](/framework/ux/doc/system/) + [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ux/doc/decisions/)), reachable from the framework nav; [ui/words/](/framework/ui/words/) (`words.js` + the live demo, in the Marks band); [ui/readme.md](/framework/ui/) refreshed with the words and the graduation rule. **The graduation rule:** a template graduates when something has to be remembered between renders - `ui/tree` is the only candidate, per the sibling [behaviors audit](/framework/ai/2026-08-21/ui-behaviors-audit/).

**Proposal, owner's call:** four values framework.css never tokenized are values no word can reach, and toggling one makes them visible - th/td padding, button padding, input padding, and .muted's literal 75%. One line each with a fallback, so nothing moves until a word declares it. Written up on this task's page, never edited.
